text: Coffee with Simone. She starts at the council on 2 November 2026, project manager role, bit nervous about the commute. Her partner Kemal is doing the cooking for her leaving drinks on the 30th. Text her the night before her first day.
Shanice got the promotion!! Team lead from 1st of December. Her boss Darius apparently fought for it. Must get her a card.

Long call with Eamon. Svetlana's retiring after 31 years at the hospital, last shift is 19 December. There's a do at the Crown on the 20th, partners invited. He thinks she'd love a proper fountain pen, she's always borrowing his. I'm driving us both there. Need to check whether the Crown does veggie, Eamon doesn't eat meat.
Xavier's housewarming is 14/11, new flat in Walthamstow. Bring a plant, not wine, he's off the booze till Christmas.
Anil was quiet at lunch. Turns out the restructure means his whole team is at risk, meeting with HR on 4 November. He's really worried about the mortgage. Check in with him after.
Tendai has left the agency. Freelancing now, mostly brand stuff for small cafes.
Noah and Chloe are having an engagement party 6th of March 2027 at her parents' place in Bath. Save the date came through today.
Liam's client dinner got cancelled, the guy from Osei Logistics pulled out last minute. He was pretty annoyed, had booked the whole back room.
Varun mentioned his manager Adriana is leaving in January for a startup. He's thinking of going for her job but hasn't decided. Ask him in a couple of weeks if he applied.
dentist 3rd of Nov 9.15, then pick up suit from dry cleaners

Nasser starts at Rossi & Partners Monday. First proper law job after the training contract. His mum is throwing a little dinner for him on Sunday, I said I'd come. Don't forget to send him good luck Sunday night.
Laura - works in procurement for the NHS trust, hates spreadsheets, loves pottery. Has a greyhound called Biscuit.

Ran into Andre outside the office. His wife Freya had their second baby last week, a girl called Ines. He's back at work 17 November after paternity leave. Andre looked shattered but happy. Get something small for the baby, maybe from that shop on the high street.
Kemal said the Christmas party is Friday 12 December this year, at the bowling place again. Meera is organising and is already stressed about the budget.
Paolo's retirement lunch was lovely. Dorota gave the speech and almost cried. Should email Paolo the photos.
Adebayo's leaving do: Thursday 27/11, the Lamb, from 6. Collection going round, chip in £10.

Ravi is moving to the Leeds office in March 2027, promotion to regional director. His wife Irina is less keen, she's just started at a school here. They're having people round on 13 December before things get mad.
Darius had his performance review today and it went badly. Says his new manager has it in for him. He's applying elsewhere quietly.
Niamh's birthday dinner is on the 8th of November at Dishoom. She hinted heavily at the Le Creuset in sage green.
Miriam starts her new job on Monday 3 November! Head of HR at a charity. Text her Monday evening to see how it went.
Bilal and Ebony are hosting a games night Saturday. I'm bringing dessert.

Caught up with Yasmin at the school gate. Her husband Liam (they call him Lee) got made redundant last month and is struggling a bit. She's picked up extra shifts at the pharmacy to cover. Their eldest is starting secondary next September. I should invite them round for dinner, something low key, maybe the weekend of 22 November.
Valentina Lopez - new client at work, runs three bakeries in Bristol. Gluten free herself, ironically. Very into cycling.
Simone's first day went well apparently, everyone was friendly and she has a window desk. Kemal sent me a photo.
Eamon's sister Niamh got into the police graduate scheme, starts training 12 January 2027. He's so proud. Congratulate her when I see her at the party.
Note to self: renew passport before the work trip on 15/02/2027.
Shanice told me her colleague Adebayo is actually going to Wang & Co, not retiring like everyone thought. His last day is still 28 November though.

Drinks with Xavier and Tendai. Xavier's anniversary with Meera is 21 November, five years, he wants to book somewhere surprising. Tendai suggested the rooftop place. Xavier also mentioned his dad's 70th is the same weekend, family party in Leicester on the 22nd. Busy man.
Freya is going back to work part time from April 2027. She's nervous about leaving the baby at nursery.
Anil update: kept his job! The restructure moved him to the data team instead. Huge relief. Send congrats.
Varun's wedding is 14 May 2027 in Goa. Invites go out in January. He asked if I'd be up for a speech, said I'd think about it.
Chloe hates surprise parties, Noah nearly ruined that. Good to know.
Paolo's daughter Valentina graduates from Manchester on 16 July. He's driving up the night before. Ask him how it went afterwards.
Dorota's dog Pierogi had surgery on his leg Tuesday. She's been off work to look after him. Should drop round with something.
Meeting with Kemal and his boss Mrs Usman went fine. They want the proposal by 5th December. I'm doing the slides over the weekend.
Nasser rang. Second week at Rossi & Partners and he already likes it more than the old place. His supervisor Irina is apparently brilliant.
Laura invited me to her 40th, Saturday 29 November, at a pottery studio of all places. Plus ones welcome. Need to RSVP by the 15th.
groceries, gym, call the bank about the overdraft
Liam - Irish, supports Leinster, doesn't drink coffee. Partner is Adriana, works at the BBC.
Bilal got the job at the airport!! Starts 1st of December on nights. Ebony's not thrilled about the shifts but they need the money. Remind me to take him for a pint before he starts.
Ravi's leaving drinks were last night. Irina came along, seemed happier about the move than before. Everyone signed a giant card. Text Ravi tomorrow to wish him luck in Leeds.
Talked to Miriam about work. The CEO there, Dr Khan, sounds intense. She's presenting to the board on 10 December and is dreading it.
Svetlana mentioned her son Noah is starting his apprenticeship at the garage on 5 January. She's also off to Riga for two weeks in February to see her sister.

Lunch with Adriana and Varun. Adriana confirmed she's leaving, last day 23 January 2027. The new startup does climate software, she's going in as COO. Varun has applied for her role, interview is 8 December. He was weirdly calm. Adriana is having a send-off at hers on the 24th and said to bring whoever. Remember to wish Varun luck the day before.
Yasmin's birthday is 2nd of February. Loves anything lavender.
Tendai's book launch party has been called off, the publisher pushed the release to spring. He's gutted but says it gives him time.
Eamon's in hospital, appendix. Op went fine this morning. Call him tomorrow.
Shanice and Darius are going to Lisbon 12-16 March 2027 for their tenth anniversary.
Andre's mum turns 80 on the 30th of November. He's organising a surprise lunch and roped me into the cake.
Kemal is a huge F1 nerd, has a signed Hamilton cap. Might be an idea for his birthday.
Called Freya back. The nursery visit went ok. She's still worried about April but Andre's going to do drop-offs.
Work gossip: Ebony from accounts is going on maternity leave in January, due early February. Meera is covering her role. Should organise a card from the team before she goes.
Simone's partner Kemal got a new job too, at the airport in ops. Starts the week after hers. They're doing a joint celebration dinner on Saturday 15 November.
Adebayo emailed. His new team at Wang & Co is lovely and the commute is half what it was.
Niamh's dinner was great. Her brother Eamon turned up straight from hospital, looking much better. She loved the pan.

Sat next to Darius at the conference. He did get the new job in the end, starts at Osei Group in January. His old manager tried to counter offer but too late. He's buzzing. His daughter Chloe has her grade 5 piano exam on 6 December, she's practising every night. Darius says she's terrified. Must send her a good luck message through him.
Not much to report from the team meeting. Usual stuff.
Irina and Ravi's house in Leeds completes on 20/02/2027. Moving van booked for the 21st.
Paolo says Dorota is going for the head of department job, interview 18th of November. She's been prepping for weeks. Text her that morning.
Valentina's bakery is opening a fourth shop on 1 March 2027, Clifton. Launch party the Friday before, I'm invited as her account manager. Bring the gift basket from the team.
